import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 10.71

by V. A. Churkin

Is the centralizer of every automorphism, or of every finite set of automorphisms,
in the automorphism group of a finite-rank free group finitely presented? This is
known for free groups of rank two and for inner automorphisms in every finite rank.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«10.71»

/-- A group is finitely presented if it is isomorphic to a presented group with
finitely many generators and finitely many relators. -/
def IsFinitelyPresentedGroup (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (rels : Finset (FreeGroup (Fin n))),
    Nonempty (G ≃* PresentedGroup (rels : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))))

/--
Is it true that, for every finite rank $n$ and every automorphism $\varphi$ of the
free group $F_n$, the centralizer of $\varphi$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_n)$ is a
finitely presented group?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))),
      IsFinitelyPresentedGroup (Subgroup.centralizer ({φ} : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))) := by
  sorry

/--
Is it true that, for every finite rank $n$ and every finite set $S$ of automorphisms
of the free group $F_n$, the centralizer of $S$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_n)$ is a
finitely presented group?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.finite_set : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n)))),
      IsFinitelyPresentedGroup
        (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))) := by
  sorry

/--
For the free group $F_2$, the centralizer in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_2)$ of every
finite set of automorphisms is a finitely presented group.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.rank_two :
    ∀ S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin 2))),
      IsFinitelyPresentedGroup
        (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin 2))))) := by
  sorry

/--
For every finite rank $n$, the centralizer in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_n)$ of every
finite set of inner automorphisms is a finitely presented group.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.inner :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n)))),
      (∀ φ ∈ S, φ ∈ Set.range (MulAut.conj :
        FreeGroup (Fin n) → MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n)))) →
      IsFinitelyPresentedGroup
        (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«10.71»

by V. A. Churkin

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«10.71»

/-- A group $G$ is *finitely presented* if it is isomorphic to a group given by a presentation
$\langle x_1, \dots, x_m \mid r_1, \dots, r_k \rangle$ with finitely many generators and
finitely many relators. -/
def IsFinitelyPresented (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (rels : Finset (FreeGroup (Fin m))),
    Nonempty (PresentedGroup (rels : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ≃* G)

/-- A group given by a presentation with finitely many generators and relators is finitely
presented. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isFinitelyPresented_presentedGroup {m : ℕ} (rels : Finset (FreeGroup (Fin m))) :
    IsFinitelyPresented (PresentedGroup (rels : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m)))) :=
  ⟨m, rels, ⟨MulEquiv.refl _⟩⟩

/-- Being finitely presented is invariant under group isomorphism. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem IsFinitelyPresented.of_mulEquiv {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] (e : G ≃* H)
    (hG : IsFinitelyPresented G) : IsFinitelyPresented H := by
  obtain ⟨m, rels, ⟨f⟩⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨m, rels, ⟨f.trans e⟩⟩

/-- The free group of finite rank is finitely presented (by the empty set of relators). -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isFinitelyPresented_freeGroup (n : ℕ) : IsFinitelyPresented (FreeGroup (Fin n)) := by
  refine ⟨n, ∅, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have h : Subgroup.normalClosure ((∅ : Finset (FreeGroup (Fin n))) : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) =
      ⊥ := le_bot_iff.mp (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (by simp))
  exact (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq h).trans QuotientGroup.quotientBot

/--
Is it true that the centralizer of any automorphism in the automorphism group of a free
group of finite rank is a finitely presented group?

That is, for every $n$ and every $\varphi \in \mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$, is the centralizer
$C_{\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)}(\varphi)$ finitely presented?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))),
      IsFinitelyPresented (Subgroup.centralizer {φ}) := by
  sorry

/--
Is it true that the centralizer of any finite set of automorphisms in the automorphism group
of a free group of finite rank is a finitely presented group?

That is, for every $n$ and every finite set $S \subseteq \mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$, is the
centralizer $C_{\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)}(S)$ finitely presented?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.finite_set : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n)))),
      IsFinitelyPresented (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))) := by
  sorry

/--
The question has a positive answer in the case of rank $2$: the centralizer of any finite set
of automorphisms (in particular, of any single automorphism) in $\mathrm{Aut}(F_2)$ is a
finitely presented group.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.rank_two (S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin 2)))) :
    IsFinitelyPresented (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin 2))))) := by
  sorry

/--
The question has a positive answer in the case of inner automorphisms for any finite rank:
the centralizer in $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ of any finite set of inner automorphisms (in
particular, of any single inner automorphism) is a finitely presented group.

Inner automorphisms are the elements of the range of `MulAut.conj`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«10.71».variants.inner (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))
    (hS : ∀ φ ∈ S, φ ∈ MulAut.conj.range) :
    IsFinitelyPresented (Subgroup.centralizer (S : Set (MulAut (FreeGroup (Fin n))))) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«10.71»
